title: Synchronous compensation cascades
pattern: Orchestrating complex fallback or rollback operations synchronously on the primary execution path.
why_bad: Cascading failures. If the recovery action fails (e.g., delete fails due to DB down), the system is left in an inconsistent state and resources are exhausted.
detection: Inline error-recovery blocks that perform synchronous database or remote mutations to undo previous steps.
counterexample: Transactional database transactions that cleanly rollback automatically without manual code.
fix: Decouple operations via transactional outboxes, asynchronous saga patterns, or background job queues.
